title: Laserboy VR
description:
Laserboy VR combines classic arcade action with modern VR gameplay, putting dual laser blasters in your hands as you dodge, weave, and fight through relentless waves of enemies. Slow time, collect powerful upgrades, and chase the perfect run across vibrant arenas.

Whether you're jumping into VR for the first time or hunting for the top score, Laserboy VR is designed for quick, satisfying gameplay that's easy to learn and hard to put down.

Wield Powerful Laser Weapons

Grab a laser blaster in each hand and unleash a storm of energy beams. Every shot feels responsive, every hit is satisfying, and every run is a chance to improve your score.

⏱ Slow Down TimeActivate Time Slow to outmaneuver incoming attacks, line up impossible shots, and turn overwhelming battles into cinematic moments.

Collect Powerful Power-UpsTurn the tide of battle with temporary upgrades:

• Super Shot — Devastating high-powered laser blasts.

• Shield — A protective energy barrier that blocks incoming attacks.

• Quad Shot — Fire four synchronized laser beams at once.

Survive Endless Enemy WavesThe arena never stops fighting back.

Battle increasingly challenging waves of:

• Flying UFOs

• Agile attack drones

How long can you survive?

Earn Coins & Upgrade Your BuildEvery run earns rewards.

Spend coins to permanently upgrade your abilities, including:

• Increased Maximum Health

• Stronger Time Slow Ability

Build your character and push even deeper into the chaos.

Customize Your LasersUnlock additional laser colors and personalize your weapons beam style.

Endless Arcade ActionNo two runs are the same.

Enemy intensity ramps up over time, challenging your reflexes, accuracy, and endurance as you fight for your next high score.

Battle Across Multiple ArenasFight through a variety of colorful environments. 

Jump in, master your weapons, and see how long you can survive in these ultimate arenas.
description_short: Laserboy VR is a fast-paced, retro-inspired VR arcade shooter. Dual-wield laser weapons, slow down time, and battle relentless waves of enemies across various arenas. Collect power-ups, upgrade your abilities, and chase the ultimate high score in endless arcade action.
